dreams.rowDetail: The Dreams behind your Journeys, shaped by your coach.

profile.usernameHelp: This is how friends find you.
profile.title: My Profile
profile.privateNote: Only you can see and edit this. Friends see only your public profile.
profile.name: Name
profile.usernameUnsaved: Not saved yet. Save it so friends can find you by this name.

app.aboutEmbedded: The version this build was installed with
app.celebrationsDetail: A short burst when you finish a step. The Journey completion celebration always stays on.
app.coachMemoryDetail: A few short lines per Journey, kept on this phone
app.coachMemoryTurnOff: Turn it off and delete what was kept
app.coachMemoryOffNow: It is off. Nothing is being kept.
app.coachMemoryOnNow: It is on. The coach keeps its reading with your account; your own sentences stay on this phone.

activeHours.title: Active Hours
activeHours.intro: Reminders only arrive during your Active Hours. A Journey can pick a narrower time, but never one outside these hours. Anything scheduled outside is moved earlier to fit.
activeHours.allDayHint: Set the same start and end time to allow reminders all day.
activeHours.perDayToggleDetail: Give each day its own hours, or turn a day off

export.label: Export my data
export.detail: Save a copy of everything on this device
export.errorBody: Something went wrong preparing your data. Please try again.

delete.label: Delete account
delete.detail: Permanently remove your account and data
delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.body: This permanently deletes your account and all of your data. This cannot be undone.
delete.acknowledge: I understand this permanently deletes my account and all my data.
delete.errorOffline: We couldn't reach the server. Try again when you're back online.
delete.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Your data was not deleted. Please try again.

developer.adaptiveReplanDetail: Force a slip and re-plan a week

restart.title: Reopen to finish
restart.body: PushApp needs to reopen to finish switching language and direction.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Your record already lives on this phone.
signIn.body: Signing in makes it recoverable if you change phone or reinstall, and it is what lets a Support Circle know who is who. Nothing here changes how the app works — you can close this and carry on.
signIn.unavailable: Sign-in is not available in this version of the app.
signIn.privacy: We only keep the sign-in itself. Your name and email stay with Apple or Google.
signIn.rowDetail: Recover your record on a new phone
signIn.signOutDetail: Your record stays on this phone.
signIn.disconnectedDetail: Your Journeys are safe on this device. The coach and your Circle will not work until the connection is back.

report.title: Help and feedback
report.rowDetail: Tell us what is wrong, or what would help
report.intro: If something is broken, confusing, or missing, tell us here. A person reads every one of these.
report.descriptionPlaceholder: What were you doing, and what did you expect instead?
report.emailHint: Optional. We only use it to answer this report, and it changes nothing about your account.
report.whatWeSend: Sent with this: your app version, the update running, your platform and OS version, and your language. Nothing from your Journeys, your Tools, your coach conversations or your messages.
report.badEmail: That address does not look right.
report.failed: We could not send it just now. Try again in a moment.
report.sentWithEmail: We have it, and we will write to you at that address.
report.sentNoEmail: We have it. You did not leave an address, so we cannot write back — that is fine, and it still helps.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Choose what we tell you about. Every change is saved immediately.

reminders.label: Journey reminders
reminders.detail: The reminder you set for each Journey, and the daily aggregate.

cheers.label: Cheers
cheers.detail: When somebody in your circle cheers you on.

nudges.label: Nudges
nudges.detail: When somebody sends you a nudge.

requests.label: Requests and invitations
requests.detail: Friend requests and Support Circle invitations.

journeyStatus.label: Journeys you support
journeyStatus.detail: When a Journey you support is paused or picked back up.

mirrorInvites.label: Mirror invitations
mirrorInvites.detail: When somebody asks what you see in them.

reach.outside: Also appears outside the app, on your lock screen.
reach.inApp: Appears in the in-app bell only.

osBlocked.title: Notifications are blocked by your system
osBlocked.body: Reminders are on here, but the operating system is refusing them. Open Settings to allow them.

notifications.footnote: Reminders are scheduled on your own device. We have no server that can send you a notification, which is why everything else arrives only when the app is opened.
